Società Sportiva Calcio Napoli, commonly known as SSC Napoli or simply Napoli, is an Italian professional football club based in Naples, Campania, that plays in Serie A, the top league of Italian football. They are among the most successful clubs in the nation, with four league titles, six Coppe Italia, three Supercoppe Italiane, and one UEFA Cup.
